**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Northwind. Targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "recruit" and "induce" surface nothing in the usual parking spots (General §30, Customer Responsibilities §12, Confidentiality §16).

In fact, clause 12.3 runs in our favour, expressly preserving Customer's freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and recording that Customer has given no no-hire commitment. That sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no non-solicit on Customer), so there is nothing to narrow to the fallback and no clause to flag.
